scholarships.name: Study Scholarships - Postgraduate Studies in the Fields of Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: This scholarship programme offers you the opportunity to continue your education in Germany with a postgraduate or complementary course of study in the fields of Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film. The scholarships also promote the exchange of experience and networking amongst colleagues.
scholarships.deadlineText: Application deadlines are updated at least once a year. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:
scholarships.sourceQuote: You can apply if you have gained a first university degree in the field of arts.

eligibility.sourceQuote: This scholarship programme offers you the opportunity to continue your education in Germany with a postgraduate or complementary course of study in the fields of Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film.
You can apply if you have gained a first university degree in the field of arts.

eligibility.textValue: years since university degree at application deadline
eligibility.sourceQuote: As a rule, your university degree should not date back more than 6 years at the time of the application deadline.

eligibility.textValue: full-time and attendance study required; part-time/e-learning not eligible
eligibility.sourceQuote: Prerequisite for the funding is a full-time and attendance study.

eligibility.textValue: months resident in Germany at application deadline must not exceed
eligibility.sourceQuote: Your application cannot be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

eligibility.textValue: language of instruction requirements must be met by start of scholarship
eligibility.sourceQuote: You should have the knowledge of the language of instruction which corresponds to the requirements of the chosen university at the latest by the time you start the scholarship.

applicability.sourceQuote: This scholarship programme offers you the opportunity to continue your education in Germany with a postgraduate or complementary course of study in the fields of Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film.
